method: Actual compiled app; visible DOM, browser cookies, HTTP responses and ordinary browser APIs only.

checks.name: Unauthenticated HTML, encoded aliases and exported payloads are server-gated with private no-store headers
Access API rejects cross-origin, bad schema and credential placement without opening finder
Browser password form rejects incorrect value and unlocks using signed host-only HttpOnly Secure cookie
Lock finder clears access cookie and subsequent navigation and RSC requests are denied
Public marketing pages expose demo and keep separate team-access link
Anonymous demo starts with exactly one labeled Target example, code 3434 and no Google/account UI
ALL/Public/Clean/Accessible/Saved filters work and rating changes affect the 4-star threshold
Private demo code auto-saves; explicit verification is separate from updates; visibility preserves checks and code edits clear them
Saved and notes can be changed without login and remain local session examples
Log a restroom adds only a local sample; private code auto-saves it and filters respect selected attributes
Reload and Reset demo restore original single example without persistent demo storage
320px and 390px list/detail/dialog have no horizontal overflow; keyboard closes details and dialog restores trigger focus
All public demo interactions issue zero Firebase requests or app API mutations, and no demo runtime exception

verdict.artifact: Protected finder and public demo compiled preview; source hashes recorded in sourceVersion
verdict.headline: I can try the product without mistaking its example code or rating for checked Target information.
verdict.in_character_reaction: The page tells me the pin is an address point and the code and access labels are examples. Code updated and Last verified are separate, and verifying clearly says it records a demo action. I can try the actions before joining anything.

visualReview: Inspected the 320px and 390px list captures and 390px complete detail capture. Text, unknown fields, sample labels and 3434 are legible; no personal identity or real visitor submission appears.
